title: Sr. Executive – Client Success & Support
description:

* Coordinate server activation and renewals.

* Maintain records of expiry dates and ensure timely renewals.
* Coordinate with service providers and internal technical teams.

* Manage Microsoft Outlook and email communications.
* Possess working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace (G Suite).
* Handle user account administration, basic troubleshooting, and DNS management.

#### **Billing & Documentation**

* Generate invoices and maintain billing records.
* Prepare quotations, proposals, order forms, and other business documents.

#### **Vendor Coordination**

* Coordinate with vendors, service providers, and business partners.

#### **Client Support**

* Provide first-level support and respond to customer queries.
* Coordinate with technical teams for timely issue resolution.
* Maintain customer communication and service records.

#### **Front Desk & Administrative Management**

* Handle front desk operations and visitor management.
* Manage incoming calls, emails, couriers, and office correspondence.
* Support general office administration activities.

#### **Sales Support & Business Coordination**

* Prepare proposals, quotations, and order forms.
* Support telecalling and lead generation activities.
* Follow up with prospects and customers.
* Maintain sales and customer databases.

#### **Meeting & Schedule Management**

* Schedule meetings, demos, and appointments.
* Coordinate meeting schedules with clients and internal teams.
* Prepare meeting agendas and maintain meeting minutes when required.

#### **Quality Management System**

* Possess knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 standards and documentation requirements.

#### **Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace (G Suite), and Zoho applications.

* Strong coordination, documentation, and organizational skills.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and work independently.

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Computer Applications, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in administration, client support, sales coordination, or office operations.

**Job Category:** Immediate Openings

**Job Locations:** Coimbatore

description:

**Job Description**
-------------------

FyerX is hiring experienced **ServiceNow Developers** for one of our clients in Coimbatore. We are looking for professionals with 3–6 years of experience in ServiceNow development, customization, workflow automation, and integrations.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in ServiceNow catalogue development, ITSM/CSM/FSM modules, scripting, and API integrations, with the ability to contribute across the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

### **Job Details**

* **Job Title:** ServiceNow Developer – ITSM / CSM / FSM
* **Experience:** 3–6 Years
* **Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
* **Working Days:** Monday to Friday
* **Working Hours:** 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
* **Industry:** IT Services / Technology
* **End Client:** KG Invicta Services (KGIS)

### **Job Summary**

We are seeking a skilled ServiceNow Developer to design, develop, customize, and maintain ServiceNow applications and modules.

The role involves end-to-end ServiceNow development, including service catalogue configuration, workflow automation, scripting, third-party integrations, testing, and application support.

The selected candidate will work across the complete development lifecycle, ensuring high-quality deliverables while following established development standards and processes.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, configure, and customize ServiceNow applications, modules, and service catalogues.
* Design and implement workflows, business rules, client scripts, and UI policies.
* Work on ServiceNow ITSM, CSM, and FSM modules.
* Develop and maintain ServiceNow integrations with external applications using REST APIs and other integration technologies.
* Perform requirement analysis, feasibility assessments, and technical estimations.
* Configure and customize Agent Workspace based on business requirements.
* Handle incident, request, and case management processes.
* Manage ServiceNow Update Sets and release deployments.
* Prepare technical documentation and maintain configuration changes.
* Develop unit test cases and perform unit and integration testing.
* Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Ensure adherence to SDLC processes, quality standards, and configuration management practices.
* Collaborate with technical and functional teams to deliver ServiceNow solutions.

### **Requirements**

* 3–6 years of experience in ServiceNow development and customization.
* Strong hands-on experience in ServiceNow Service Catalogue development.
* Good understanding of ServiceNow ITSM, CSM, and/or FSM modules.
* Proficiency in ServiceNow scripting and configuration, including:

  + Business Rules
  + Client Scripts
  + UI Policies
  + Workflows
  + Agent Workspace
* Experience in ServiceNow Update Sets and release management.
* Working knowledge of REST API integrations and third-party system connectivity.
* Understanding of software configuration management tools and processes.
* Knowledge of SDLC, software estimation techniques, and quality processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* ServiceNow certifications such as CSA, CAD, or CIS.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with enterprise applications such as SAP.
* Knowledge of SAP CPI or similar integration technologies.
* Experience in ServiceNow UI development and customization.
* Understanding of ServiceNow reporting and analytics.
* Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and CMMI quality standards.
* Experience in application testing, debugging, and performance optimization.

title: Supervisor III, Applications Development
description:
**The** **Opportunity:**
------------------------

Oversees day-to-day operational objectives through the supervision of a team of application development engineers, ensuring efficient software build, release, deployment, and configuration management. Sets objectives that directly impact operational plans, contributing to the implementation of new applications, deployment frameworks, automation processes, and software quality standards. Evaluates and refines work methods, recommending enhancements to improve software implementation effectiveness, deployment efficiency, and system stability. Works on technical challenges that require data analysis, troubleshooting, and strategic consideration of infrastructure dependencies. Communicates regularly with internal teams, including QA, IT, and cloud operations, to align release strategies with organizational priorities. Engages external partners, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure smooth coordination in deployment efforts and software updates.  
  

About the Role

We are converting this position from contract to full-time. Sanjay built the automation layer that now vets every release. We need someone who owns the quality strategy, manages a small team of test engineers, and keeps our AI-driven test infrastructure running as product demands grow.

You will report to the Senior QA Manager, Development team. You will work with product, platform, and DevOps teams. You decide what "good enough to ship" means for our applications; you build the systems that prove it.

  
  

What You'll Own



Automation architecture. Design and maintain test frameworks on the Appvance AI Quality Platform. You decide how tests get structured, how data flows through them, and where they plug into our release pipeline.

* Team management. Directly manage 2–4 test automation engineers. Set their weekly priorities. Review their pull requests. Run 1:1s. Write their annual performance reviews. You decide who takes which feature area. You decide whether their work meets our standards before it merges.

* AI application testing. Build test suites that validate LLM-based features. Test prompt regression. Verify RAG workflows. Detect hallucinations. Validate agent behavior. Use LangChain and LangSmith.

* Scripting and tooling.Write and review Appvance Designer Scripts. Write JavaScript/TypeScript code. Build API test suites for REST and GraphQL. You set the coding standards others follow.

* CI/CD integration.Wire tests into GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and AWS deployments. When a build fails, your tests tell us why within minutes.

* Cross-platform coverage. Ensure web, mobile, desktop, and API layers each have appropriate automated coverage. Cover functional, regression, smoke, integration, end-to-end, security, performance, and database scenarios.

* Quality metrics.Track failure rates, flakiness, coverage gaps, and release-blocking defects. Present these to leadership in plain language.

* Hiring and growth.Interview candidates for automation roles. Write growth plans for your reports. Push them toward harder problems. Do not let them stay comfortable.

* Incident support. Join production release calls. Respond to critical incidents when automation uncovers—or misses—something that hits customers.

  
  

What You've Done Before

* 2–3 years hands-on with the Appvance AI Quality Platform, including Appvance Designer Scripting.

* You write clean JavaScript ES6+ and TypeScript. You read production-grade code and you write it.

* You tested AI-powered applications with LangChain and LangSmith. You validated prompts. You checked response accuracy. You verified RAG pipelines.

* You built or maintained test frameworks for UI, API, database, and cross-browser scenarios.

* You integrated test suites into Git, GitHub, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS, and CI/CD workflows.

* You worked with SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB) data stores.

* You know REST APIs, GraphQL, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, JWT.

* You worked in Agile/Scrum. You know SDLC, STLC, and defect lifecycle.

* You managed or mentored at least one other engineer, even informally.

* Bachelor's or master's in CS, IT, or equivalent.

  
  

How You Work

  
  

* You debug like a detective. When a test fails, you do not re-run it and hope. You trace the failure to its source.

* You write code others can read. Your scripts have clear structure. You comment where needed. Your naming stays consistent.

* You communicate across roles. You explain a flaky test to a product manager. You explain a coverage gap to a director.

* You care about shipping speed. You know the difference between a test that catches real bugs and a test that slows releases but adds no value.

* You give direct feedback. Your reports know where they stand because you tell them.

  
  

Work Environment

  
  

* Hybrid, following our Coimbatore office policy.

* Primarily computer-based work.

* Availability for production releases and critical incidents as needed.

**Disclaimer:**
  
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

**Why Avantor?**

**Dare to go further in your career.** Join our global team of 14,000+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life-changing science.
  
  
**The work we do changes people's lives for the better.** It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. It enables medical devices that help a little boy hear his mom's voice for the first time. Outcomes such as these create unlimited opportunities for you to contribute your talents, learn new skills and grow your career at Avantor.

title: UI Architect
description:
**About Ginesys**

Ginesys is India's leading retail technology platform, powering 1,200+ customers and 50,000+ users through the unified GinesysOne suite — ERP, Cloud POS (Zwing), Order Management (Browntape), GST Compliance (EaseMyGST), and BI (InsightX). We are evolving from a System of Records to a System of Intelligence through Ginesys.AI.

**Role Summary**

The UI Architect is the single accountable owner of enterprise UI architecture across all products. This person defines the design system, reusable foundation layer, and UI governance model that every product team builds on — enabling consistent, scalable, and intuitive experiences across ERP, POS, OMS, WMS, Reporting, and future modules.

This is a matrix leadership role. The UI Architect does not own product-specific design decisions or engineering implementation — those stay with Product Managers and Engineering respectively. Instead, this role sets the standards, patterns, and governance those decisions must work within, and partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Customer Success to apply them.

This is a hands-on architecture and design leadership role. The person doesn't just define standards on paper — they build reusable component libraries, foundation screens, and research-backed patterns that product teams consume directly.

**What This Role Owns**

* **Enterprise UI/UX architecture:** the long-term design architecture strategy across all products.
* **Enterprise Design System:** tokens, typography, color, spacing, grid, components, patterns, accessibility, and responsive standards — owned and evolved centrally.
* **UI Foundation Layer:** reusable screens and patterns (auth, navigation, dashboards, tables, forms, filters, notifications, empty / loading / error states) that every product consumes.
* **Design capability building:** mentoring UI developers and leads and guiding front-end engineers on usability principles.

**What This Role Does Not Own**

* **Product roadmap or feature prioritization:** owned by Product Managers.
* **Product-specific UX decisions:** co-owned with Product Managers within the enterprise design system — this role sets the standards, Product Managers decide the product's specific workflows.
* **Engineering implementation and technology stack decisions:** owned by Engineering Architects; this role ensures designs are aligned with and feasible on the chosen stack.
* **People management of designers embedded in product teams:** reporting model to be confirmed with leadership.
* **Brand identity and marketing collateral:** owned by Marketing/Brand, where such a function exists; this role ensures product UX stays brand-compliant.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Enterprise UI/UX Architecture**

* Define the long-term UI architecture strategy across all products and own the scalable enterprise design framework.
* Establish standardized UI principles, reusable interaction models, navigation frameworks, and common user journeys for enterprise workflows.
* Define information architecture standards and a scalable component taxonomy that enables rapid product development.

**UI Foundation Layer**

* Architect and standardize a reusable UI foundation layer — authentication, navigation, search, dashboards, notifications, tables/data grids, forms, filters, pagination, reports, wizards, dialogs, and standard empty/loading/error/success states.
* Ensure this foundation reduces implementation effort for every future product and module.

**Product-Specific UX Partnership**

* Partner with Product Managers to design differentiated experiences for ERP, POS, OMS, WMS, Inventory, Finance, Reporting, and AI-enabled workflows.
* Translate business workflows into intuitive digital experiences within the enterprise design system.

**Technology Alignment**

* Collaborate with Engineering Architects to ensure designs align with the technology stack and are technically scalable.
* Partner with engineering teams through implementation to protect design intent.

**Matrix Collaboration And Leadership**

* Work across Product Management, Engineering, Customer Support, Customer Success, Sales, and Implementation teams — influencing without direct authority.
* Mentor UI developers, guide front-end engineers, and conduct design workshops to build organizational design capability.

**Continuous Innovation**

* Track industry trends (AI-powered UX, conversational interfaces, design automation, micro-frontends, cross-platform design) and recommend adoption where it strengthens the enterprise experience.

**Required Experience**

14+ years in UI design and architecture, including at least 5+ years leading enterprise design systems.

Experience architecting UI across multiple products in an enterprise SaaS organization.

Deep expertise in design systems, accessibility standards, and interaction pattern architecture.

Strong front-end technical fluency (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, React/Angular/Vue) to credibly partner with engineering.

Experience running UI governance — design reviews, quality gates, and pattern library management.

Experience operating in a matrix organization — influencing Product, Engineering, and Customer Success without direct authority.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, or a related discipline; Master's degree preferred.

**Helpful Experience**

Retail domain experience — POS, ERP, Order Management, Warehouse Management, Omnichannel Retail, e-commerce, or Supply Chain.

Experience with the specific design and front-end tooling in use (Figma, FigJam, Storybook, design tokens, micro-frontend architecture).

Exposure to AI-enabled product experiences and conversational interfaces.

Experience working with globally distributed product and engineering teams.

**Benefits**:

We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as:

Ginesys Academy for holistic training and development Comprehensive health insurance coverage Excellent rewards and recognition policy

Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year

Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country. Annual Ginesys walkathon & related sporting events. Quarterly Coffee with the CEO and more!

**Here’s our story; now tell us yours**

Ginesys is India’s best omni retail suite backed by Ginesys, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online retail, offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200 + brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 400+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionize retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite. We have a pan India presence with offices in major cities including Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Coimbatore & Goa and are expanding rapidly. We love the challenges of retail and are busy solving them to create a great retail tech suite. Ginesys core mission is to continue to build world-class internal service capabilities, in a bid to deliver outstanding external service value to customers. We are an ISO-certified and SOC compliant company having won myriad awards for our innovation and support. For further information, please visit our websitehttp://ginesys.in/http://ginesys.in

title: Branch Admin Executive – Coworking Operations
description:
**Job Title: Branch Admin Executive – Coworking Operations**

**Company:** Betaspace Coworking  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 1–3 years of relevant experience  
Contact Number : 0091 9500 8187 02

**About Betaspace**

Betaspace provides managed offices, private offices, coworking desks, meeting rooms, and virtual office services. We aim to provide clean, comfortable, well-maintained workspaces supported by responsive service.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and responsible Branch Admin Executive to handle the daily operations of a Betaspace branch.

You will ensure the branch is ready for clients, supervise housekeeping and support staff, attend to client requirements, coordinate maintenance, and follow up on operational tasks. This is an active, on-site role requiring regular walkthroughs, direct staff coordination, and ownership of issues until they are resolved.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**1. Branch Readiness and Daily Operations**

* Conduct a morning walkthrough to ensure the branch is clean, organised, and ready for clients.
* Check reception, workstations, cabins, meeting rooms, pantry, washrooms, and common areas.
* Conduct regular checks throughout the day and address operational gaps promptly.
* Follow branch opening and closing procedures and maintain relevant checklists.

**2. Housekeeping and Support Staff Supervision**

* Monitor housekeeping and other assigned support staff attendance.
* Assign daily duties and verify that work is completed properly.
* Ensure washrooms, pantry, desks, floors, and waste bins are cleaned regularly.
* Arrange corrective cleaning whenever required.
* Report staff shortages, attendance concerns, and repeated service gaps to the manager.

**3. Client Service and Relationship Management**

* Act as the branch contact for day-to-day client requirements.
* Respond professionally to requests, complaints, and feedback.
* Coordinate solutions with the appropriate staff, vendors, or manager.
* Track issues until completion and confirm resolution with clients.
* Maintain courteous communication and a welcoming branch environment.

**4. Facility Checks**

* Check internet connectivity, Wi-Fi, AC, lighting, drinking water, and washroom facilities.
* Monitor UPS and generator readiness through approved checks and coordination with authorised personnel.
* Identify faults, record issues, and arrange timely follow-up.
* Escalate interruptions that affect client operations immediately.

**5. Maintenance and Vendor Coordination**

* Identify repairs and maintenance requirements during branch walkthroughs.
* Coordinate technician visits, vendor access, and service schedules.
* Obtain quotations and management approval where required.
* Follow up on pending repairs and verify completion.
* Maintain maintenance records and highlight recurring problems.

**6. Enquiries, Branch Tours, and Follow-ups**

* Handle incoming calls, walk-in enquiries, and workspace enquiries professionally.
* Understand prospective clients’ requirements and explain available workspace options.
* Conduct branch tours and share approved pricing and service information.
* Record enquiry details and coordinate follow-ups with the manager or sales team.

**7. Occupancy and Booking Coordination**

* Maintain accurate information on occupied and available seats and cabins.
* Coordinate meeting room bookings, day passes, and workspace allocations.
* Ensure booked spaces are ready before client arrival.
* Track expected move-ins, move-outs, and changes in client requirements.

**8. Client Onboarding and Exit**

* Coordinate workspace preparation before new clients move in.
* Follow up on required documents and internal onboarding formalities.
* Coordinate access cards, keys, and workspace handovers.
* Assist with exit inspections, access card returns, and handover records.

**9. Payment, Renewal, and Documentation Follow-up**

* Coordinate with the accounts team on assigned payment follow-ups.
* Record client payment commitments and share updates with the relevant team.
* Follow up on renewals and pending documents.
* Escalate overdue commitments and unresolved documentation requirements.

**10. Supplies and Branch Records**

* Monitor housekeeping materials, pantry supplies, stationery, and other essential consumables.
* Raise replenishment requests before supplies run out.
* Maintain visitor, courier, key, access card, inventory, and other assigned branch records.
* Maintain clear supporting records for approved purchases and expenses.

**11. Security and Closing Checks**

* Monitor visitor entry and coordinate with security personnel where available.
* Report unauthorised access, security concerns, or unusual incidents promptly.
* Ensure equipment, lights, AC, doors, and keys are checked according to branch closing procedures.

**12. Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Submit a daily branch operations report before leaving for the day.
* Report checks completed, work handled, client issues, maintenance updates, and pending tasks.
* Mention the action taken, current status, next step, and support required.
* Report urgent issues immediately.
* Suggest practical improvements to cleanliness, client experience, facility upkeep, and branch operations.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Any graduate; candidates with a diploma and relevant practical experience may also apply.
* 1–3 years of experience in office administration, facility coordination, coworking operations, front office, hospitality, or customer service.
* Experience supervising housekeeping or support staff is preferred.
* Experience handling clients, vendors, and maintenance follow-ups is an advantage.

**Required Skills**

* Good spoken Tamil and working proficiency in English.
* Professional communication and client-handling skills.
* Basic knowledge of email, Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, and daily reporting.
* Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to prioritise tasks and follow up consistently.
* Willingness to conduct regular branch walkthroughs and supervise work directly.
* Ability to handle routine issues independently and seek support when required.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A clean, organised, and client-ready branch.
* Housekeeping and support duties completed consistently.
* Client requests acknowledged and followed through to resolution.
* Maintenance issues identified early and tracked to completion.
* Accurate branch records and timely daily reports.
* Reliable follow-up on enquiries, payments, and pending tasks.

**Work Arrangement**

This is a full-time, on-site position in Coimbatore. The assigned branch, working hours, weekly off, salary, and benefits will be communicated during the recruitment process.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹18,000.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Education:

* Master's (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

Location:

description:
